Exam Date & Time: 07-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  Pattern Recognition [CSE-3274]  
Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Compare and contrast single linkage and complete linkage clustering.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyse the concept of Convolutional Neural Network for the purpose of digit  
  recognition.  
  Describe the layers and justify their selection in terms of feature extraction and        (5)  
  classification.  
  
2)           Make use of bagging and boosting in the context of ensemble learning. What is the  
  key difference between the two?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyse the role of learning rate and activation functions in the training process of a  
  CNN.                                                                                      (5)  
  
3)           Summarize the steps involved in the Fuzzy C-Means algorithm with a suitable  
  diagram.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Construct the formula of precision and recall, commonly used performance metrics  
  for classifier evaluation. When would you prefer one over the other?                      (2)  
  
  C)      Estimate the final clusters for the given table data using single linkage and complete  
  linkage clustering. Show the all calculation steps for the both clustering techniques.  
  
  
  (5)  
  
  
4)           Identify the likelihood function in the context of Bayes classification? How is it  
  mathematically defined for a given class and observation?  
  (5)  
  A)

B)         Analyse the concept of Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and its role in statistical  
  pattern recognition. Describe how ANOVA helps in feature selection by comparing      (5)  
  variances between classes.  
  
5)              Identify Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-Score for the given confusion matrix,  
  Predicted Positive        Predicted Negative  
  Actual Positive        50                        10  
  A)  
  Actual Negative        5                         35                                 (5)  
  
  
  B)         Compare single layer and multi-layer perceptron using a suitable example.            (3)  
  C)         Illustrate how to select the value of K in K-means clustering?                       (2)  
  
-----End-----
